name: Return to Jitters
summary: At Raven Hill, you bring Jitters a meal from Chef Grual. The cakes ease his hunger, though fear still holds him there.

sections.title: A Dubious Delicacy
sections.body: Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. With little livestock or sea life in Duskwood, he makes use of what the blighted forest provides. His Dusky Crab Cakes contain no crab meat. Instead, gooey legs from venom web spiders make up his specialty. Grual calls it resourceful cooking, though delicate stomachs may disagree.

sections.title: Soothing Jitters' Nerves
sections.body: At Raven Hill, Jitters cowers in fear, unable to face the horrors that drove him from the woods. Terror keeps him from hunting or foraging, and hunger only deepens his distress. The warm cakes bring him a rare moment of relief. Desperate for food, he eats without asking what kind of crab Grual used.

faq.q: What is in the Dusky Crab Cakes?
aliases: what are dusky crab cakes made of
faq.answer: Dusky Crab Cakes contain no crab. Chef Grual uses gooey legs from local venom web spiders and seasons them to mimic traditional seafood cakes.

faq.q: Does Jitters know the cakes are made of spider goo?
aliases: does jitters know about the spiders
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps the recipe to himself. Starved and terrified, Jitters eagerly eats the cakes without asking what is in them.

faq.q: Why couldn't Jitters get his own food?
faq.answer: Jitters is overwhelmed by fear after what he encountered in Duskwood's wild woods. Panic keeps him near Raven Hill, where he depends on sympathetic travelers for food.
Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. With the town cut off by shadows and beasts, he uses unconventional ingredients scavengers bring him to feed the tavern's patrons.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start jitters food quest
faq.answer: Jitters asks for help with his hunger at Raven Hill in Jitters' Growling Gut. You hunt venom web spiders for Chef Grual, then return with the finished meal.
The meal satisfies Jitters' hunger, and he gives you his heartfelt gratitude. Food cannot ease his deep terror; he remains anxious and haunted by the forest's dark secrets.

angles.text: Chef Grual turns gooey venom web spider legs into palatable cakes, showing how cooking draws on whatever the frontier provides.
Darkshire's meager, unusual diet reflects how cut off the town is from Stormwind's supplies. Locals rely on whatever creeps in the shadows.
